scripts.build: pnpm run types && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist
scripts.lint: oxlint src test vitest.config.ts && pnpm run typecheck
scripts.lint:fix: oxlint --fix src test vitest.config.ts && pnpm run typecheck
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run types && tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p test/tsconfig.json
